entries.t: <FACE:28>Bwa ha ha ha! Your<NL>efforts end here!
<FACE:27>You will never take<NL>this Block! Never!
<FACE:01>What! What do you<NL>mean?
<FACE:27>Because my true<NL>identity is…
<FACE:05>Quit being coy and<NL>show your face!<WAIT><FACE:07>Ni<DELAY:000F>·<DELAY:000F>wa<DELAY:000F>·<DELAY:000F>ka<DELAY:000F>!<DELAY:000A>
<FACE:27>Whaaaaat!
<FACE:25>H-how did you know!?<WAIT><FACE:05>Thought we wouldn't<NL>know? That attitude…
<FACE:06>And those sneaky plans<NL>of one who knows us!
<FACE:22>Yes! Well, if you've<NL>found me out…
<FACE:22>Indeed, I am…<NL>the one you elected<WAIT>the great Niwaka, your<NL>class president!
<FACE:22>You see… after I left<NL>you all behind<WAIT>I wormed my way into<NL>the Sperobo Gang<WAIT><FACE:22>With my overflowing<NL>political talent<WAIT>I climbed all the way<NL>to officer!
<FACE:22>Say your pointless<NL>fight wins this Block<WAIT>What will you do then?
<FACE:22>Surely you don't think<NL>you can steer this<WAIT>on your own and get<NL>back to Earth?
<FACE:24>Bwa ha ha ha!<NL>Quite impossible!<WAIT><FACE:22>The energy needed to<NL>set course for Earth<WAIT>is nearly gone!<NL>
<FACE:22>Borrowing Sperobo tech<NL>is far more sensible!
<FACE:22>Now then, everyone!<NL>Come to my side
<FACE:22>Especially!<NL><WAIT>Those who voted for me<NL>in the last election…
<FACE:22>I pulled some strings<NL>and I have the list
<FACE:22>For you I'll arrange<NL>something special:<WAIT>posts as officer<NL>candidates!
<FACE:15>(Does he really think<NL> he's still popular…)
<FACE:1D>(That last election<NL> was pure fraud…)
<FACE:06>Are you stupid?<NL><WAIT>Think anyone in class<NL>still listens to you?<WAIT>Besides, the president<NL>job you shoved off…<WAIT>It's <PLAYER>, period!
<FACE:25>Absurd!<NL><WAIT>That was no legitimate<NL>election! It's void!
<FACE:06>Void nothing! Everyone<NL>knows how hard<WAIT><PLAYER> has worked<NL>all this time!<WAIT>We're all sick of a<NL>two-faced president!
<FACE:06>You should just turn<NL>into space dust!<WAIT>I'll grab you and toss<NL>you out the airlock!
<FACE:06>Right, everyone? …Huh?
<FACE:09>What's wrong?
<FACE:29>No, it's just… you've<NL>got a fierce side…
<FACE:08>O-oh no! What am I<NL>saying!
<FACE:14>Well, true enough…<NL><WAIT>Ask who's president<NL>now and it's <PLAYER>…
<FACE:19>Yeah, yeah, say what<NL>you like, he's solid
<FACE:11>Heh… not the way you<NL>won, but what you did<WAIT>That NO.1 Medafighter<NL>title had me fooled
<FACE:0F>Thanks to you, my eyes<NL>are open
<FACE:04>Niwaka, the Sperobos<NL>are bad guys<WAIT>It's not right to take<NL>orders from them<WAIT>Come back to class<NL>with us
<FACE:6C>It seems making you an<NL>officer<WAIT>to keep these brats in<NL>line was a mistake

<FACE:25>No… so you made me an<NL>officer as a tactic…<WAIT>Not for my ability…<WAIT><FACE:72>Well, you did buy us<NL>time<WAIT><FACE:7B>Thanks to that we made<NL>it back to base!<WAIT><FACE:73>…You… are used up…<WAIT><FACE:75>Ugh… for no reason…<NL>cough<WAIT>Becoming an officer is<NL>not that easy… cough!
<FACE:05>That's what you get<NL>Serves you right
<FACE:04>Niwaka…<NL>If they tricked you…
<FACE:23>Shut uuuuup!<NL>
<FACE:23>Then I'll show you<NL>what I can really do!
<FACE:7D>What now? Kind of feel<NL>bad for him-robo…
<FACE:7D>And losing this place<NL>now is bad-robo…<WAIT>We need to stall-robo<NL>
<FACE:7D>He is an officer after<NL>all; do him a favor<WAIT>and something good<NL>will come of it-robo<WAIT>Fine, let's back him<NL>up-robo!
<FACE:23>What are you doing!<NL><WAIT>Of course the troops<NL>must help an officer!<WAIT>Whatever the story, an<NL>officer's word is law<WAIT>That's the basics of<NL>any organization!
<FACE:81>Eeeek-robo! He hasn't<NL>changed a bit-roboo!
<FACE:04>Niwaka… feel better<NL>now? Come back to us
<FACE:06>Hey, <PLAYER>!<NL>You're way too nice<WAIT>He betrayed the class<NL>to be their officer!
<FACE:04>No, but if he rose to<NL>Sperobo officer,<WAIT>he'd know their aims,<NL>wouldn't he?<NL>
<FACE:00>Right, Niwaka?<NL><WAIT>If you know, would you<NL>help us out?<WAIT><FACE:05>No need for such<NL>obvious flattery
<FACE:05>The gear here can get<NL>us to Earth anyway…
<FACE:22>Help?… Their aims…!<NL>
<FACE:22>Yes! I do indeed hold<NL>valuable information!<WAIT>Their goal? I know it<NL>perfectly well!
<FACE:22>I see!<NL><WAIT>So the fate of the<NL>class rests on me!<WAIT>In the end I always<NL>take the lead…<WAIT><FACE:24>Was I born under such<NL>a star, I wonder?
<FACE:03>Uh… well… anyway…<NL><WAIT>We need to take back<NL>the Cluster controls…

<FACE:22>They mean to haul this<NL>Cluster to their base<WAIT>and use it as their<NL>own facility!<WAIT>Their base is deep in<NL>this asteroid belt<WAIT>They hollowed out an<NL>asteroid to live in<WAIT>They'll lash the<NL>Cluster onto it<WAIT>and use it just as it<NL>is!<WAIT><FACE:00>So when do we reach<NL>this base?<WAIT><FACE:22>Huh? The report said<NL>10 minutes…
<FACE:05>10 minutes from when?<WAIT><FACE:22>Well, roughly…<NL>
<FACE:22>…about 10 minutes ago<NL>
<FACE:22>Ah, yes…<NL><WAIT>Like this, we crash<NL>into the base…
<FACE:22>The base's arms clamp<NL>the Cluster down…
<FACE:12>This is bad!<NL><WAIT>The boosters are<NL>blocked! We can't go!
<FACE:22>Yes… they did mention<NL>that. A key point…
<FACE:03>So… once again…<NL>we've lost control…
<FACE:06>Or rather, it's worse<NL>than before!
<FACE:A0>Niiiwaaakaaa!
<FACE:81>T-this is bad-robo!<NL><WAIT><PLAYER> is here-robo!<NL><WAIT>W-what do we do-robo?
<FACE:27>Leave them be<NL><WAIT>They are about to<NL><WAIT>see a shocking truth<NL>with their own eyes…
<FACE:28>Heh heh heh…
<FACE:01>This is the final<NL>Block!<NL><WAIT>Everyone!<NL><WAIT>Let's go!
<FACE:0A>Without us noticing,<NL>he's gotten reliable
<FACE:07>Heh heh<NL><WAIT>Maybe the one who grew<NL>most here was <PLAYER>
<FACE:23>Now then, here I go!
